odvs.description: win11cis_password_expiry_warning_days is the policy setting determines how far in advance users are warned that their password will expire. The recommended state for this setting is: between 5 and 14 days.
odvs.name: password_expiry_warning_days

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "2.3.7.8 | PATCH | Ensure Interactive logon Prompt user to change password before expiration is set to between 5 and 14 days"
  when: win11cis_rule_2_3_7_8
  tags:
    - level1-corporate-enterprise-environment
    - patch
    - automated
    - rule_2.3.7.8
    - NIST800-171_3.5.2
    - NIST800-53R5_IA-5_1
  block:
    - name: "2.3.7.8 | PATCH | Ensure Interactive logon Prompt user to change password before expiration is set to between 5 and 14 days | Apply Settings To Registry"
      when:
        - win11cis_password_expiry_warning_days >= 5
        - win11cis_password_expiry_warning_days <= 14
      ansible.windows.win_regedit:
        path: HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows Nt\Currentversion\Winlogon
        name: PasswordExpiryWarning
        data: "{{ win11cis_password_expiry_warning_days }}"
        type: dword

    - name: "2.3.7.8 | AUDIT | Ensure Interactive logon Prompt user to change password before expiration is set to between 5 and 14 days | Warning Check For Variable Standards"
      when: win11cis_password_expiry_warning_days < 5 or win11cis_password_expiry_warning_days > 14
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! You have an invalid number of days set for win11cis_password_expiry_warning_days. Please read"
          - "the notes for the variable and make the necessary change to the variable to be in compliance"

    - name: "2.3.7.8 | AUDIT | Ensure Interactive logon Prompt user to change password before expiration is set to between 5 and 14 days | Warn Count"
      when: win11cis_password_expiry_warning_days < 5 or win11cis_password_expiry_warning_days > 14
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '2.3.7.8'
